# Давид Мисакян

> > Professional portfolio of David Misakyan, concert lighting designer and stage design specialist working with leading Russian artists and theaters.

David Misakyan is a lighting designer, video designer, and stage design specialist with extensive experience in Russia's concert and theater industry. His portfolio includes collaborations with major artists like Би-2, Полина Гагарина, Диана Арбенина, and prestigious venues including Театр Олега Табакова.
